# ListNavigateController

> Coordinates roving focus, ARIA selection sync, and child select events for list-based components.

## Constructor

```ts
new ListNavigateController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ListNavigateOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `itemSelector` | `string` | no |  |
| `ariaAttr` | `'aria-selected' | 'aria-checked' | 'aria-current'` | no |  |
| `autoSync` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'` | no |  |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `onChildSelect` | `(detail: { value: string` | no |  |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `rovingFocus` | `RovingFocusController` | yes |

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-change` | _(none)_ |

## Usage

```ts
import { ListNavigateController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ListNavigateController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
